question: Which causal entry-time morphology, trend, pullback, volatility, volume, structure, direction, or clock segment consistently separates better and worse K1-to-K2 outcomes on both halves of 2023?

owner_authorization.scope: autonomous 5min/15min research; this stage is diagnostic and does not mutate a trading rule
owner_authorization.holdout_policy: one final use only after a later single-variable candidate clears every pre-holdout gate

signal_frozen.core: K1 directional real body truly crosses SMA(HL2); K2 wick touches it while the full body and close remain on the directional side
signal_frozen.secondary_score: same twelve-component equal-weight causal score as predecessor

diagnostic_design.threshold_source: feature values of baseline-accepted 2023H1 trades; outcomes do not set thresholds
diagnostic_design.score: minimum of the arm-minus-baseline mean net bp improvements in 2023H1 and 2023H2
diagnostic_design.familywise_null: shuffle net outcomes within each half-year, preserve all causal arm memberships, and compare the observed maximum stable score with 20000 permutation maxima
diagnostic_design.nomination_rule: nominate exactly one arm per timeframe only when sample-eligible, stable improvement is at least 5bp in both halves, combined arm net is at least -10bp per trade, and neither half has zero observations
diagnostic_design.tie_break: higher stable improvement, higher combined net, more events, then lexical arm id
diagnostic_design.claim_limit: post-entry outcome segmentation on the frozen accepted ledger; any nomination must be preregistered as a new single-variable experiment and rerun before cooldown before it can be called a strategy improvement

matched_control.role: not used to select a diagnostic arm; a later exact single-variable experiment must build the registered matched random control
